newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays soft, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays soft, seen rangebound.

text.p: * Ringgit retreats further on light corporate demand for dollar
* Dollar's weakness against yen likely to limit ringgit's fall
* Ringgit seen rangebound ahead of holiday in Malaysia
The ringgit retreated further against the dollar in early Asian trading on light corporate demand for the dollar, dealers said.
But immediate upside for the dollar/ringgit is likely to be capped at 2.5100 given the dollar's weakness against the yen, dealers said.
They said the ringgit was expected to trade in a tight range due to lack of fresh factors and ahead of a holiday in Malaysia on Thursday.
"It's mostly positions adjustment. I don't think there will be much activity ahead of the holiday," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
At 0200 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5085/90 a dollar against 2.5073/80 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday.
